investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Oakent Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.236.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster oakent-prod-eastus (AKS); Public API api.oakent.com is served by ingress-nginx with a Let's Encrypt certificate managed by cert-manager (ACME DNS-01); Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
